featured_reviews.name: Varsha AI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Minara Masjid is a mosque located in the city of Mumbai, India. It was built in the 18th century by a businessman named Siraj ud-Daula Muhammad Khan. The mosque is situated in the bustling area of Mohammad Ali Road, which is known for its lively street markets and food stalls.

The Minara Masjid is an impressive structure with tall minarets and a large dome. It has a spacious prayer hall and can accommodate a large number of worshippers at once. The mosque is open to people of all faiths and is a popular destination for tourists who come to admire its architecture and learn about Islamic culture.

In addition to serving as a place of worship, the Minara Masjid is also actively involved in social and charitable work. The mosque runs several programs to provide aid to the needy and support education and healthcare initiatives in the local community.

customer_updates.text: "I recently attended the urban art festival at Sassoon Docks in Mumbai and it was an incredible experience! featured_reviews.name: Buccaneer2.0
featured_reviews.review_text:
Islam Gymkhana - 4 Stars 🌟🌟🌟🌟

A historic gem in Mumbai, Islam Gymkhana has stood proudly on Marine Drive since its establishment in 1890, representing more than just sports—it’s a cultural landmark. The lush green lawns outside are nothing short of stunning, offering a serene escape in the heart of the bustling city. 🌳✨

The view? Simply spectacular! Picture this: the expansive sky merging with the Arabian Sea, a golden sunset painting the horizon, the smooth stretch of Marine Drive, and the comforting feel of the grassy lawns underfoot. 🌅🌴 The perfect combination of natural beauty and urban life.

What makes it even more convenient is the location—just steps away from the railway station exit, making it easily accessible for everyone. 🚉 A stroll here feels like stepping into a calm oasis, where the rush of the city meets the soothing sound of the waves. 🌊

Whether you’re here for a game, an event, or just to soak in the peaceful vibes, Islam Gymkhana offers a slice of serenity in the heart of Mumbai’s hustle. Truly a place where history meets beauty!

featured_reviews.name: Ashraf Qureshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Islam Gymkhana is a historic social & sporting club located on Marine Drive.
The land was allotted in 1890, and the club has a large, sea-facing property (around 19,300 sq. m) with both open grounds and built-up areas.
Membership used to be restricted to Muslims but now is open to people of all communities.

featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text: Good ground for cricket. We had our annual cricket matches here this year. Village Cricket League (VCL) is an established tournament in Bandra / Mumbai. I found the ground to be maintained and perfect for summer. Basic amenities are available.

featured_reviews.name: Shahid Momin
featured_reviews.review_text:
Huge Space, Great Vibes! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

featured_reviews.name: ABBAS ALI ARIF
featured_reviews.review_text: Islam Gymkhana came into existence in 1890, Lord Harris, the then Governor allotted the Islam Gymkhana grounds on the Kennedy Sea Face which is popularly known as Marine Drive and now Netaji Subhas Road. They have Resturant servicing food & snacks for guest. It has a big Ground which can be used for playing cricket, walking or football. They have a AC Banquet Hall to host different functions. They have massage, steam & jacuzzi facility for members. Restroom facility available for members & guest. They have a car parking facility for guest. It is located very close to marine lines railway station.

featured_reviews.review_text: I can't put in words how much I appreciate this humble family owned place being where it is, offering God honest tasty Maharashtrian food at honest to God prices. The stars don't do real justice to this place because rating in stars is comparison with other places, and there isn't anything like this place around. The food is good and you can have your fill without breaking bank. 2 real chapatis, 2 pc fry fishes, a half rice a couple small bowls of fish curry and a sol kadhi and my bill was 200, God bless this place.

featured_reviews.name: Amol Pednekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Taste : 3 Stars
Economy : 5 Stars
Ambiance : 3 Stars
Service : 4 Stars
Value For Money : 4 Stars

Gravy items taste was relatively good but fried fish was disappointing. Quantity was also good.

Note : If you are looking for budget Seafood restaurant, then this is the place. You won't get disappointed.

Their rates are really low. You can have a meal in less than Rs. 100.
But taste is average.

featured_reviews.name: nigel faleiro
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very very economically priced, taste was good too not heavy on stomach, very pleasant experience and quick service.
Seeing the prices on the menu I was wondering if the food or quantity would be any good but I was wrong. The size of the chapatis were bigger than most other expensive places, had a good number of meaty chicken pieces and very less bones 👌🏻
Only gripe was the menu card was dusty

Do keep up the good taste and service

featured_reviews.name: Volney Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text: No fuss quantity for the price. Owners actually don't want to make a fortune running this place. They're only earning their daily bread by selling food for so cheap in such an area. Hence, don't complain. Order lot's of fish. Very reasonable prices. A haven for fish lovers.

featured_reviews.name: yuvraj chauhan
featured_reviews.review_text: Okay experience,crab lollipop was good but fish thali was not good(taste) at all...

featured_reviews.name: PETAL SMOOTH
featured_reviews.review_text: Avoid this place. Restaurant is very dirty, service is very poor. Food is served cold especially roti & rice. Their onions are rotten. They don't give additional lemon wedges. There are just two waiters & both are very obnoxious. They clean the table with dirty cloth & with the same dirty hands they serve roti with bare hands. They don't serve roti in a separate dish/basket. They don't have tissues for patrons to clean their dirty cutlery. The kitchen is also very dirty. The manager treats you like why did you come here, if you wouldn't have come then I would have continued my relaxing session. I won't ever go there again.

featured_reviews.name: Mehwish Mujeeb Rehman Shaik
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice balance of quality and quantity. Owner aka Bhau Who's at counter, is greatly humble and gem of a person. Offered extra food for my children, with no extra cost at all. Water service bhau is superbly generous person. Quiet ambience. It was open even after 10.30pm. Bangda fry, bombil fry, yummm... Sea food lovers must visit the place for sure

featured_reviews.name: Vivas Bagwe
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst Smelly Place. Maybe good for daily wagers or those who give a damn to cleanliness and hygiene. Tables were covered with dust and the plates were bent like used a lot types.  Not okay for kids and family and definitely  not a office or home outing or party kind of place. Better avoid. Maybe popular with daily wagers or those on a shoe string budget or as I mentioned above... people who do not bother about cleanliness. Better Avoid if you can... I searched for this place on Google..went there. ..entered.. had a look and came out at double the speed I went in with my family..on Wednesday 21 Nov 2018 at 2 pm.

You won't feel you are in such a crowded city once you are at this club. Highly recommended place. The memberships are open now....

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text: A fantastic place to unwind from your busy corporate life. Whether you love angling (fishing) or not... take a flat bottom boat n let it gently drift in the lake while you soak in the nature n read a book. If you love fishing there are plenty of rohus, catlas, mirgals, silver carp... to try n catch.  For hardcore anglers they can test their skills with some gentle monster size (15-25kgs) fish. Possibly the only club thats open 24 x 7; 365 days. Monsoons are magical here...

featured_reviews.name: M.A Ghani
featured_reviews.review_text: Only Angling club Mumbai has over a decade now. Been going since was 7yrs old. Beautiful place for any Avid Angler and in the middle of concrete jungle.

featured_reviews.name: Soumitra Bhattacharya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went first time on Saturday evening. They have given Parshe fish which was not fresh and I realised the moment I started cooking.
The lady there argued over the phone and questioned on cooking styles instead of accepting their poor fish quality.
Moreover the cost is much higher that other Bengali fish vendors in Mumbai across Malad and Goregaon.
More than anything the attitude matters and this places definitely have no mannerism to deal appropriately with customers as they already have a huge customer based as they says and feels that Google reviews of this sort does not matter to them.
Please be mindful of that.

featured_reviews.name: Subir Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
A wide variety of fairly fresh Bengali and local sea fish varieties and excellent cutting of the fish in traditional style makes it the go to shop for fish lovers in the Kandivali- Borivali area.
Also available are traditional Bengali versions of pulses, condiments and other typical food/ seasoning items such as Nolen Gur, Kashundi, Sattu, Chinese noodles, Muri, Chanachur, Ghee, Bori, Pachphoron, Yellow mustard seeds etc. Fresh cut chicken and processed frozen chicken items and eggs are also available at reasonable rates.
Seasonal fish like Illish, topshe etc are also available here

featured_reviews.name: Nabarun Dev
featured_reviews.review_text:
Variety of fresh water fishes are available but prices are very high. Same fish available in Borivali west market with much lower price also with same quality.
Also get seasoned vegetables from Kolkata, price is insane (Brinjal is Rs200/KG).

featured_reviews.name: Sudeshna Saha
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good bengali fish available. We've been regularly going there from Mira road. Gur, achar, dal, spices etc available too. Seasonal veggies too are good, but expensive.

featured_reviews.name: swapnil kamble
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice fish but still price is high as compared to area surrounding it...first the shop was at Gundecha area but it is now at Siddharth Nagar which is really low profile area

featured_reviews.review_text:

No overcharging or fleecing customers during the lockdown
This place has always ensured good quality meats and most importantly, Service here has always been a friendly experience.

Thank you!

featured_reviews.name: Sourav Saha
featured_reviews.review_text: Good quality fresh fish available here. In any case found rotten, they change the fish then and there only. Customer is king for them and price is very reasonable and lower than Kolkata. Other than fish, most of the Bengali items like Bapi chanachur, all kind of Bengali spices, rice, daal, fresh Kolkata vegetables available here. Best time to visit is Saturday morning.

featured_reviews.name: Sohag Satpati
featured_reviews.review_text: Good place in thakur village for regular needs for fish and some bengali masala and stuff in thakur village.

featured_reviews.name: Muntakem Haque
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent place to buy fresh high quality fish. Most fresh water fishes are available here, along with few sea fishes. A must visit place for any Bong or similar fish-loving community. Apart from fish, this place also has spices, snacks and other stuff popular in Bengal.
I hope they had live fish, like we are used to in Bengal.
The staff is very friendly and cooperative.
